newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends mixed, March up on pricing.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends mixed, March up on pricing.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures ended mixed but were firmer than their counterparts in Kansas City or Chicago thanks to flour pricing in the March contract, traders said.

"The problem is that Chicago is reflecting a U.S. export market that's weak and Minneapolis is reflecting a domestic market that still has plenty of interested buyers at lower levels," a MGE trader said.
MGE spring wheat settled 4-1/2 cents per bushel lower to 1/4 cent higher, with December down 3-1/4 cents at $4.13 a bushel. March gained 1/4 cent to close at $4.00-3/4.

Traders said they saw significant scale down mill-type pricing orders in March as it dropped below $4.00. That, along with a relative lack of nearby demand, allowed the Dec/March inverse to narrow, trading from 15 down to around 13-1/2 cents per bushel.
CIS bear-spread one million March/Dec at 13-1/2 cents. Wilson and Garnac each bought one million Dec. Wilson, LFG and Country Hedging each sold one million March, traders said.
MGE barley futures settled 10 cents per cwt lower, with Dec down 10 cents at $6.70 per cwt.
